title: Non-Existence of thick bubble rings at low Weber numbers
summary: We examine the existence of thick bubble rings within the framework of the free-boundary capillary Euler equations, focusing on the regime of low Weber numbers. Although spheroidal bubbles are known to approach a spherical shape in this limit, the possibility of thick bubble rings persisting at low Weber numbers has remained uncertain. In contrast to the ordinary Euler equations, which admit thick vortex ring solutions, our analysis reveals that the free-boundary capillary Euler equations do not support thick bubble rings at low Weber numbers.
